title: Verified agriculture and pest source research for PeruRoad Climate
scope: PE-22 / Rimac corridor and Mantaro / Junin; national and out-of-corridor products explicitly labelled
toolPolicy: Discovery and extraction used Tavily MCP only; source accessibility is not an API contract.

sources.title: Official agrometeorological bulletin catalogue
sources.geographicScope: Peru; individual products have different coverage
observedFacts: Catalogue links dated October 2026 potato and maize risk outlooks, daily insect and disease conditions, and Sierra impact reports.
limitations: A catalogue date is not an outbreak date; linked documents require separate validation.
sources.automation: html_link_discovery_verified: Parse product sections and linked PDF URLs. Do not construct filenames or infer missing editions.

sources.title: Potato agroclimatic risk outlook, October–December 2026
sources.geographicScope: National regional outlook; includes Sierra Central
observedFacts: Sierra Central outlook describes mainly low/medium risk, localized high risk, and sensitivity to moisture availability and abrupt temperature drops. Monthly updates are stated.
limitations: Forecast, not confirmed crop losses. No Mantaro field coordinates or exact issue day extracted. Regional text cannot locate a PE-22 incident.
sources.automation: pdf_text_extraction_verified: Discover updates from catalogue; preserve forecast period and region. Map interpretation needs manual review.

sources.title: Maize agroclimatic risk outlook, October–December 2026
sources.geographicScope: National regional outlook; includes Sierra Central
observedFacts: Sierra Central outlook identifies mostly low/medium risk, planting moisture constraints and possible localized hail, wind or abrupt temperature effects. Monthly updates are stated.
limitations: Forecast, not observed damage. Basic extraction initially failed; advanced extraction succeeded. Exact issue day and field coordinates unavailable.
sources.automation: advanced_pdf_extraction_verified: Discover catalogue link; retain seasonal scale. Never turn regional outlook into a confirmed road disruption.

sources.title: Insect pest environmental conditions outlook N284
sources.geographicScope: Coastal fruit fly and Amazonian coffee borer outlook; no local Mantaro outbreak
observedFacts: Predicts environmental suitability for fruit fly and coffee borer; identifies hourly GFS input at 27×27 km. Product states experimental evaluation status.
limitations: Expired at verification. Suitability is not a pest detection. Text extraction includes stray February dates and layout residues; maps need review.
sources.automation: pdf_text_extraction_verified: Retain forecast label and four-day validity; block expired forecasts from current-alert presentation.
sources.dateEvidence: Publication date is the catalogue label; forecast dates independently match the PDF heading.

sources.title: Crop disease environmental conditions outlook N284
sources.geographicScope: Selected national stations; Huaral, Huánuco and other regions
observedFacts: Includes coffee rust, strawberry grey mould, blueberry botrytis and grape powdery mildew. Describes predictive models and GFS input at 27×27 km.
limitations: Expired at verification; experimental product. Environmental risk is not confirmed infection. Huaral and Huánuco are not the target PE-22/Mantaro corridor.
sources.automation: pdf_text_extraction_verified: Keep station geography and disease-specific forecast periods; require review before assigning a local alert.
sources.dateEvidence: Publication date is the catalogue label; forecast dates independently match the PDF heading.

sources.title: Sierra agrometeorological impacts, September29–October5 2026
sources.geographicScope: Extracted stations in Cajamarca, Ancash and Arequipa; no Junin entry
observedFacts: Contains dated crop phenology, measured weather and recommendations. At Quilcate, reports potato condition and rainfall; fungal disease is discussed as potential risk.
limitations: Historical report interval: 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-05. Catalogue date is 2026-09-29, not proven publication date. No confirmed target-corridor pest outbreak.
sources.automation: pdf_text_extraction_verified: Preserve observation interval separately from forecast validity; distinguish measured values from conditional disease advice.

sources.title: SIGIA public pesticide registration consultation
observedFacts: Extracted page identifies agricultural-input management and pesticide registry queries by product, crop and pest.
limitations: Not a pest occurrence feed. Extracted HTML contains navigation, not query results or a documented API.
sources.automation: manual_review_required: Use for registry reference only; public query/API automation and export formats remain unverified.

sources.title: Official explanation of phytosanitary surveillance verification
observedFacts: Explains monitoring, occurrence notifications, specialist verification and diagnostic-centre samples before recording pest information.
limitations: Undated article body; current site-header date is not its publication date. Guidance is not a current outbreak or public dataset.
sources.automation: manual_review_required: Require dated official detection/diagnosis and locality before accepting pest occurrence; no documented public feed extracted.

sources.accessStatus: tavily_extraction_success; report later closes the event
sources.title: Complementary report 14162: forest fire at Ayas, Surco, Huarochirí
sources.geographicScope: Ayas annex, Surco district, Huarochirí province, Lima; exact point and affected-field polygon unavailable.
observedFacts: A forest fire began at Ayas on 30 September 2026 at 12:49; the COEN report says it was extinguished and subsequently closed.
The damage table updated 2 October 10:55 reports 45 ha of agricultural crops affected and 25 ha of natural cover destroyed.
Affected crops/vegetation named include avocado, cherimoya, alfalfa, quince, tuna and eucalyptus; no deaths or injuries were reported.
limitations: This historical closed incident is not a current fire alert or a road closure.
The damage table's stated update time should be retained; later report time is not the damage-measurement time.
The document names the Ayas annex but provides no exact point coordinate or affected-field polygon.
sources.automation: Version report updates, separate occurrence and damage-assessment times, retain area units/crop list/closed status, and leave geometry null unless an official point or field polygon is supplied.

findings.interpretation: No dated local plant-pest detection was verified; the follow-up did verify one closed local wildfire report with agricultural crop loss. Lack of a pest record is not evidence of absence.
findings.primaryAutomationCandidate: SENAMHI bulletin catalogue HTML links and separately validated PDFs
findings.sigiaCorrection: Pesticide registration data, not phytosanitary outbreak notifications.
